title: Frame a continuous stream
prompt: Real TCP delivers frames glued together and split apart. Implement `static List<string> DecodeStream(byte[] streamBytes)` that decodes ALL frames concatenated in one buffer (the common localhost reality: two writes arrive in one read), throwing ArgumentException if the stream ends mid-frame. The test concatenates three encoded frames into one buffer plus a truncated fourth, and expects two clean decodes then a throw... implement `static List<string> DecodeStreamSafe(byte[] streamBytes)` that returns all COMPLETE frames and ignores a trailing partial frame (the tolerant reader every real protocol needs).

tests.name: glued-frames
tests.hint: Loop: read prefix, validate remaining, slice payload, advance offset.

tests.name: trailing-partial-tolerated
tests.hint: Same loop, but if 4 + len > remaining: stop (return what you have) instead of throwing.
